programs.title: Gordon Buchanan: My Epic Camel Adventure
programs.desc: Scottish filmmaker and TV presenter Gordon Buchanan begins his expedition through the Gobi Desert.He decides to do it on a camel, a traditional Mongolian means of transport.An animal adapted to living in a dry and hot climate will help it survive in the wilderness, rocky plains, desert dunes and the dangerous Bumbat Mountain.Gordon wants to get to know his animal companions better.It provides them with food and benefits from the warmth of their fur.He also benefits from the hospitality of nomads who live a wandering lifestyle.The journey helps him understand that climate change has direct consequences not only for animals, but also for people who inhabit the vast steppes.

programs.title: Mammals - Making Of
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of the production of a nature production presenting the life of mammals.The most diverse phylum of the animal kingdom includes both the tiny Etruscan shrew and the blue whale.

programs.title: Blue Planet Revisited
programs.desc: A team of scientists and researchers of the aquatic environment is looking at changes taking place in the underwater world.They want to show viewers the state of ocean waters on the eastern coast of America, the Bahamas and the Great Barrier Reef of Australia and show the life of, among others,whales and their young and turtle hatchlings.The program is a compilation of the most interesting fragments of footage recorded during the "Blue Planet Live" project in March 2019, which consisted of week-long broadcasts of large-scale undersea research.

programs.title: Dynasties II
programs.desc: The authors present the fate of wild animals that, living in often difficult conditions, persistently fight for the survival of their families.Each episode concerns a representative of a different species and members of its herd.Viewers will learn, among others:the story of the eight-year-old cheetah Kali, a resident of the grassy plains in western Zambia.Despite her relatively old age, the female desperately protects her family, teaching her daughters to be independent.A resident of Kenya, an inexperienced elephant, tries to secure the existence of her twins and unite the herd after the death of the leader.A puma from Patagonia takes care of four cubs alone.The program also features croquets, whose females are fighting an internal fight for dominance, as well as a young meerkat queen and Mac the macaque, trying to maintain his dominant role in the herd and father an offspring, thus initiating his own monkey dynasty.
